product_name: Motorola Edge 70 5G (Bronze Green, 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage) | Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 | 6.7" P-OLED 120Hz Display | 50MP Dual Rear Camera | 50MP Front Camera | 5000mAh Battery | 68W Charging
description: ☆【RAM, ROM And Expandable】:- 8GB RAM with 256GB internal storage for smooth multitasking, app usage, photo storage and daily productivity; no expandable card slot support. ☆【Display】:- 6.7-inch P-OLED display with 1220 x 2712 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, HDR10+ support and up to 4500 nits peak brightness for sharp visuals and smooth viewing. ☆【Camera】:- 50MP main camera with OIS and multi-directional PDAF + 50MP ultrawide camera for detailed shots and wider framing; 50MP front camera supports selfies and high-resolution video calls. ☆【Processor】:- Powered by Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 octa-core processor with Adreno 722 GPU, designed for responsive performance, multitasking, entertainment and everyday smartphone use. ☆【Battery】:- 5000 mAh battery with 68W wired charging and 15W wireless charging support for dependable daily usage and convenient recharging.
